Tallow Grid raises EUR 2.5 million seed round

Tallow Grid has raised EUR 2.5 million in seed funding led by Arctic Ventures.

Tallow Grid is headquartered in Helsinki, Finland, and builds energy-trading software for district heating operators.

The company now has 14 employees across Finland and Estonia and plans to double the team next year.

The Finnish energy software market has drawn steady early-stage investment as utilities move trading and forecasting work to cloud tools.
